Coverage.description: Independent coverage dimensions; loss is not hidden by otherwise available values.

available.description: Whether copied evidence is available at this read boundary.

counter_overflow.description: An exact counter exceeded its fixed-width representation.

curtailed.description: Collection or access refused observations; inspect the independent loss counts.

dropped_detail.description: Old detail events displaced by the bounded rolling ring.

dropped_updates.description: Producer updates lost to contention or attempted after termination.

enabled.description: Whether collection was requested; disabled is absent coverage.

interrupted.description: The owner guard ended without an explicit terminal explanation.

refused_items.description: Items refused by catalogue, field or collection bounds.

sampled.description: Recent aggregates or detail have reduced temporal/detail resolution.

stale.description: The active operation has no sufficiently fresh published checkpoint.

OperationId.description: Process instance plus local sequence; never a semantic or cache identity.

process_instance.description: Process-local instance locator; not a semantic identity or attestation.

OperationSummary.description: Small copied catalogue entry without metric or scientific ownership.

finished_at.description: Actual owner completion time, when known.

id.description: Diagnostic identity of the associated operation.

kind.description: Bounded producer-supplied operation or phase description.

outcome.description: Explicit owner terminal explanation, or none while active or unavailable.

summary.description: Producer-declared responsibility and finite copied-output lifetime.

SummaryCoverage.description: Explicit lifetime/admission losses for producer-declared compact outputs.

expired.description: Outputs whose selected terminal lifetime elapsed.

pressure_lost.description: Oldest terminal outputs displaced to preserve active admission.

refused.description: Declarations or terminal copies refused by bounds/contention/opt-out.

SummaryPublication.description: Generic producer-owned compact explanation; it grants no execution ownership.

expires_at.description: Finite terminal output deadline; absent for an active declaration or a refused copy.

purpose.description: Bounded producer-supplied purpose, never interpreted by the hub.

description: Bounded catalogue pagination with separate collection coverage.

coverage.description: Independent availability, freshness and loss facts.

next_offset.description: Next current-catalogue offset, when more entries are present.

summaries.description: Summary admission and loss facts, separate from scientific metrics.
